description:
List agent knowledge sources

Returns every knowledge source attached to one voice agent, newest first. These are the documents the agent may draw on when answering, added either as a crawled web page or as literal text. The response is a plain list with no paging. Entries belong to the account that owns the agent, so a reseller key that reads a customer agent sees the same entries as the customer.

agentId.description: Identifier of the voice agent. Accepted either as the public form `agent_12` or as the bare number `12`; the prefix is stripped before the lookup.
